problem_statement: POST /v1/auth/login returns 500 for valid credentials (not the expected 401 for bad ones).
gold_patch: Call getUserByEmail(email) instead of getUserById(email) at src/services/auth.service.js:15 (revert of bug_patch).

runtime_workload.cmd: register+login probe against the instrumented app

runtime_dependence: Static cannot know getUserById(email) throws — the call looks type-valid in source. Only at runtime does findById try to cast an email string to an ObjectId and raise a CastError; NEAT's incident message ('Cast to ObjectId failed for value "...@e.com" ... path _id') names the misuse. Genuinely runtime-only signal — NEAT wins.

root_cause.detail: Calls getUserById(email) instead of getUserByEmail(email); findById casts email->ObjectId -> CastError -> 500.

neat_signal.note: Runtime CastError message directly reveals email-used-as-id; static cannot know findById(email) throws.
